SELECT SUM(p.product_price) AS total_value
FROM Order_Deliveries od
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON od.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE od.delivery_status_code = 'Delivered';
